meta.name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Season 8 Motion Comic
meta.description: Buffy's adventures continue with new threats, old friends and brand new stories that await the Slayer.

videos.title: Issue 1: The Long Way Home (1)
videos.overview: Buffy is learning to deal with life since all the Slayers were activated and Sunnydale was destroyed. Meanwhile, the Military has decided that Buffy is trouble and has rescued Amy and another from the ruins of Sunnydale and recruited them to kill Buffy.

videos.title: Issue 2: The Long Way Home (2)
videos.overview: Amy traps Buffy in a nightmare and attacks the slayers with an army of living dead.

videos.title: Issue 3: The Long Way Home (3)
videos.overview: Amy's attack on Buffy is revealed to be a diversion for her real goal, to capture Willow.

videos.title: Issue 4: The Long Way Home (4)
videos.overview: Buffy storms the military's complex to rescue Willow.

videos.title: Issue 5: The Chain
videos.overview: A decoy of the real Buffy Summers is sent underground to stop Yamanh from leading his army to the surface.

videos.title: Issue 6: No Future For You (1)
videos.overview: Faith is approached by Giles with a dangerous assignment--to pose as a British aristocrat in order to assassinate a wealthy, rogue slayer under the tutelage of an Irish warlock.

videos.title: Issue 7: No Future For You (2)
videos.overview: Posing as a viscount's daughter, Faith infiltrates Lady Genevieve's gala and is attacked by Roden's gargoyle security team. Elsewhere, Willow offers to Dawn with her plus-sized problem and is called upon to upgrade the castle's defense system.

videos.title: Issue 8: No Future For You (3)
videos.overview: As Giles tries hopelessly to contact Faith, Lady Genevieve explains her rationale for wanting to assassinate Buffy.

videos.title: Issue 9: No Future For You (4)
videos.overview: As Faith and Genevieve battle to the death, Buffy confronts Giles about Faith's assignment.

videos.title: Issue 10: Anywhere But Here
videos.overview: After a flight of fantasy, Buffy and Willow enter the demonic lair of Sephrilian, a dangerous realm of unstable reality where the friends' darkest secrets, both past and future, are revealed.

videos.title: Issue 11: A Beautiful Sunset
videos.overview: While clearing a vampire nest, Buffy and Satsu are confronted by Twilight.

videos.title: Issue 12: Wolves at the Gate (1)
videos.overview: Dracula and his minions invade the castle and take Buffy's Scythe. Buffy and Satsu have a one-night stand.

videos.title: Issue 13: Wolves at the Gate (2)
videos.overview: One of Buffy's slayers in Japan tracks down the vampires that attacked Buffy in Scotland. Xander goes to find out what Dracula knows about these vampires.

videos.title: Issue 14: Wolves at the Gate (3)
videos.overview: Dracula, Xander and Renee arrive in Japan. Buffy and Willow learn what Raidon's gang's plan is for the scythe.

videos.title: Issue 15: Wolves at the Gate (4)
videos.overview: Buffy and her slayers stop Raidon and his vampires in Japan.

videos.title: Issue 16: Time Of Your Life (1)
videos.overview: Buffy and Willow travel to New York and Buffy is transported to the future.

videos.title: Issue 17: Time Of Your Life (2)
videos.overview: Buffy and Fray begin to try to figure out why Buffy was brought to the future.

videos.title: Issue 18: Time Of Your Life (3)
videos.overview: Buffy finds the hideout of Melaka's brother and Willow finds out how to return Buffy to the present.

videos.title: Issue 19: Time Of Your Life (4)
videos.overview: Buffy returns from the future, but will what she learned there erase the future from happening?
